title: Horizon and Landfall
author: Ines Zhou
blurb: Emrys Iversen, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
